_comment: Per batch: the arms from an earlier batch that are its control cell, so the viewer shows them beside the batch's own arms. `after` is the knob token of the batch's own group the reference slots in behind (its knob value's place in the sweep); without it the reference goes at the end. Edit when a batch is queued (queue-batch skill, step 1c). `value` is the reference cell's value of the batch's knob, as the batch's specs spell it; tools/progress_update.py slots the reference row into the batch table by it. `knob: "name"` says the batch has no single knob (b19's switches): each arm's name token is its cell.

b8.label: control: b4, fc (200,100) x 8 epochs, at 100M

b15.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, entropy 0.01 fixed -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b16.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, target_KL off (0) -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b17.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, clip 0.2, no anneal -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b18.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, grad-norm clip 0.5 -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b19.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, all switches at the base: adv-norm on, huber, Adam eps 1e-7, vf 0.5 -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b20.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, 128 lanes -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b21.label: reference: b7 fc (320,) cell, lambda 0.98, shaping 0.1, gate 75 -- the base b15-b21 were generated from

b22.label: reference: b9 lambda 0.99 cell (gamma 0.99, rollout 128) -- the base of the corner-grid ladder

b23.label: reference: b22's g999roll512 cell, the rung below (gamma 0.999, lambda 0.99, rollout 512, huber, no anneal)

b24.label: reference: b23's g999roll512msehold cell at 50M (gamma 0.999, lambda 0.99, T 512, mse, clip 0.2->0.001 held from 80%) -- the ladder's top rung, which b25 runs at 200M

b25.label: reference: b23's g999roll512msehold cell at 50M -- the same config b25 runs at 200M and 8 seeds

b26.label: reference: b24's hzanneal50 cell -- the same config with no step penalty, but the 30-value observation era and a 200M cap, so a loose reference only; b26's own pen0 cell is the control for the 26-value observation

b27.label: reference: b26's pen01 cell (step penalty 0.01, no history) at 50M and 4 seeds -- the same base b27 runs at 100M with 8 seeds; b27's own hist0 cell is the like-for-like control

b28.label: reference: b27's hist8 cell at 100M with the anneal reaching its final values at 50% -- b28 runs the same hist8 config at 200M with the anneal final at 25%

b29.label: reference: b27's hist8 cell at 100M (gamma/lambda/entropy annealed to 0.999/0.999/0.001 by 50M, lr and clip fixed) -- b29 fixes those three and anneals lr 2.5e-4->0 and clip 0.2->0.001 over the whole 100M

b30.label: reference: b27's hist8 cell at 100M with gamma and lambda annealed to 0.999 -- b30 anneals them to 1.0 over the same 50M

b31.label: reference: b27's hist8 cell at 100M with the huber value loss -- b31 is the same config and ramp with mse
